title: Arquitectura de Datos e IA en Oracle Cloud

nodes.label: Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse 26ai o Superior

edges.label: model
edges.meaning: Agent Flows uses configured foundation models with the required permissions.

edges.label: memory
edges.meaning: Proposed custom persistent-memory integration. Native agent memory lasts for the session.
edges.style: original source connector; proposed integration explained in caption

edges.label: requirement
edges.meaning: Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse 26ai or above is required for AI features.

conceptualAnnotations.medallion: Landing, Bronze, Silver and Gold are conceptual data stages, not separately provisioned services.
conceptualAnnotations.catalog: Master Catalog registers metadata, without an implied automatic synchronization.
conceptualAnnotations.lineage: Preview; supported instrumented executions, latest capture only, no lineage history.
conceptualAnnotations.streaming: Structured Streaming for supported volume/workspace paths, Delta tables and Kafka-compatible sources/sinks. No direct oci:// or Oracle database readStream/writeStream paths.
conceptualAnnotations.agentMemory: The connection proposes custom persistence in Oracle AI Database 26ai; it is not native session memory.

presentation.scope: User-supplied layout with Oracle Analytics Cloud and its connector removed. Remaining geometry is uniformly enlarged and centered; rounded gray catalog/lineage/agent tags, reference-green streaming and red input/AI connectors. Label blocks are taller, with wider lineage/agent tags aligned to the left/right edges of Master Catalog, centered text and adjusted catalog connection endpoints; Memory and LLM labels use Oracle Red.

provenance.adaptation: Original source preserved byte for byte. User-requested removal of Oracle Analytics Cloud, uniform enlargement/centering of the remaining layout, taller rounded gray tags and wider lineage/agent tags aligned to the left/right edges of Master Catalog, red Memory/LLM labels and connectors, and reference-green streaming with white text. Remaining icons, labels and connector routes retained with endpoints adjusted to the taller catalog block.
